common.noAccess: You do not have access to this page. Ask an INOK super administrator if you need it.
common.conflict: You cannot decide on this one: you have been involved with this partner (for example as a member, or by setting it up). Another reviewer needs to decide.
common.reasonHint: The partner can read this reason, so please write it clearly and politely.

home.title: Catalogue administration
home.intro: Everything about partners, suppliers and products in one place. You only see the parts you have permission for.

queues.partnersHint: Set up partner organisations, send invitations, approve or pause them.
queues.suppliersHint: Suppliers sent by partners that wait for a decision.
queues.productsHint: Products and product changes that wait for a decision.
queues.importsHint: How many catalogue uploads failed, and why this cannot be listed yet.

home.noStatsAccess: Figures are shown to people with a reporting or review permission.
home.statsFailed: The figures could not be loaded. Please try again.

stats.outdatedNote: Availability last confirmed more than 90 days ago.
stats.requests30d: Buyer requests in the last 30 days
stats.responseRateNote: {responded} of {requests} requests have had a first response.
stats.medianNote: Half of the answered requests were answered faster than this.

home.statsNote: These are plain counts from the database. Nothing is estimated.

partners.title: Partners
partners.intro: A partner is an organisation that adds suppliers and products to the catalogue. A partner can only add content after INOK has approved it.
partners.provisionIntro: INOK creates the partner organisation as approved and emails an invitation to its owner. The owner accepts it, signs in and turns on two-step sign-in. You do not become a member.

fields.orgNameHint: The legal or trading name, 2 to 160 characters.
fields.displayName: Name shown to buyers and in lists
fields.ownerEmailHint: The invitation link is sent here. It works once and expires in 7 days.

partners.empty: There are no partners here yet.

explain.pending: Created by the organisation. It cannot add anything until INOK approves it.
explain.approved: Can add suppliers and products and answer buyer requests.
explain.suspended: Paused. Its suppliers and products are hidden from buyers and it cannot accept requests.

partners.noteHint: Kept in the record. Leave empty if there is nothing to add.
partners.suspendWarning: Pausing hides every supplier and product of this partner from buyers at once and stops new buyer requests.
partners.resendHelp: Only possible while the partner has no owner yet. The earlier link stops working.

suppliers.title: Supplier review
suppliers.intro: Check what the partner sent and decide. The review is about documents and contact details only.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers are waiting for a decision.

detail.title: Supplier
detail.unavailable: This supplier is not available to you. It may not exist, it may not have been sent for review yet, or you may have been involved with its partner, in which case another reviewer must decide.
detail.liveNote: This supplier is already approved. Buyers keep seeing this version until the new one is approved.
detail.contactNote: Only INOK reviewers can see these. They are never shown to buyers.
detail.noContact: No contact details have been saved.
detail.docsNote: A document can be opened only after the file check has passed.
detail.decideIntro: Every decision is recorded with your name, the time and your reason, and the partner is told.
detail.checksHint: Choose at least one. Buyers will see only these checks and the date of the review.
detail.approveDateNote: Today is recorded automatically as the review date.
detail.infoHint: The supplier goes back to the partner. Say clearly what is missing.
detail.rejectHint: Say clearly why. The partner can change the details and send them again.
detail.suspendHint: Pausing hides the supplier and all of its products from buyers at once.
detail.reinstateHint: The supplier becomes approved again, and its published products are shown to buyers again.

products.title: Product review
products.intro: Products and product changes that partners have sent. Compare, look at the preview and decide.
products.empty: No products are waiting for a decision.

preview.label: Preview as a buyer would see it

detail.title: Product
detail.unavailable: This product is not available to you. It may not exist, it may still be a draft, or you may have been involved with its partner, in which case another reviewer must decide.
detail.noRevision: There is no version waiting for review.
detail.changedCount: {n} fields differ from the published product.
detail.firstSubmission: This product has not been published before. Every field is new.
detail.previewNote: This is how the version sent for review would look to buyers once it is published.
detail.noImages: No pictures were sent with this version.
detail.imagesNote: Only pictures that passed the file check are shown here.
detail.noDecisionYet: No decision has been made on this version yet.
detail.historyGap: Older versions and decisions are not listed here yet. The audit log has the full record.
detail.decideIntro: Every decision is recorded with your name, the time and your reason, and the partner is told.
detail.approveHint: The partner can then publish it. Approving does not publish it.
detail.changesHint: The partner can edit and send it again. Say clearly what to change.
detail.rejectHint: Say clearly why. The partner can still prepare a new version.
detail.suspendHint: Pausing hides the product from buyers at once.
detail.reinstateHint: The product is not shown to buyers again by itself: the partner must publish it again.

reports.title: Product reports
reports.intro: Buyers can report a product. Look at the product, then dismiss the report or pause the product. Either way you must give a reason.

empty.actioned: No report has led to a pause yet.
empty.dismissed: No report has been dismissed yet.

reports.dismissHint: The product stays as it is.
reports.suspendHint: The product is hidden from buyers at once, and every open report on it is closed.

imports.title: Import activity
imports.intro: Partners can upload product lists. Uploads only ever create drafts, which still need a review.
imports.failedNote: Uploads where no row could be used.
imports.rowsNote: Rows with a problem or a repeated product code, across all uploads.
imports.gap: A list of single uploads with the partner and the reasons for each failure is not available yet. The database gives administrators the totals above only. A partner can see the details of its own uploads on its import page.

messages.partnerProvisioned: The partner was created and the invitation was sent to the owner.
messages.partnerResent: A new invitation was sent. The earlier link no longer works.
messages.supplierApproved: The supplier is approved. The review date was recorded.
messages.supplierRejected: The supplier was not approved. The partner has been told why.
messages.supplierInfoRequested: More information was requested. The partner has been told.
messages.supplierSuspended: The supplier is paused and hidden from buyers.
messages.productApproved: The product is approved. The partner can now publish it.
messages.productRejected: The product was not approved. The partner has been told why.
messages.productChangesRequested: Changes were requested. The partner has been told.
messages.productSuspended: The product is paused and hidden from buyers.
messages.productReinstated: The product is back with the partner. It is not shown to buyers until the partner publishes it again.
messages.reportActioned: The product was paused and the reports on it were closed.
